workflow_lab_results_inbox.name: 1. Aviva Lab Results Inbox Workflow
workflow_lab_results_inbox.description: Reads incoming lab-report emails, extracts analytical data, categorizes test parameters, and orchestrates Excel updates with Microsoft 365. High volume, deterministic precision.

steps.name: Fetch Emails (M365)
steps.desc: Retrieves unread lab emails via Microsoft Graph API.
steps.routing_rationale: Massive context extraction. ₹42/1M token rate preserves margin on heavy document reads. Asynchronous batching prevents 60 RPM limit crashes.

steps.name: Fetch Excel Tracker
steps.desc: Reads current lot status from master Excel.
steps.routing_rationale: Massive context extraction. ₹42/1M token rate preserves margin on heavy document reads. Asynchronous batching prevents 60 RPM limit crashes.

steps.name: Extract Analytical Data
steps.desc: Extracts exact lab metrics from attached PDF.
steps.routing_rationale: Massive context extraction. ₹42/1M token rate preserves margin on heavy document reads. Asynchronous batching prevents 60 RPM limit crashes.

steps.name: Evaluate Guardrails
steps.desc: Checks for NA, human-locks, and Micro vs Analytical logic.
steps.routing_rationale: Financial/Compliance logic requires absolute SOTA accuracy (TAU Banking #1). Trading margin for precision is mandatory here to prevent regulatory liabilities.

steps.name: Update Excel Cells
steps.desc: Writes color-coded status back to Excel via API.
steps.routing_rationale: Tool execution and JSON generation requires sub-second TTFT latency (243 tok/s). Premium reasoning models waste margin on deterministic tool calls.

steps.name: Save to OneDrive
steps.desc: Archives source PDF into organized SharePoint folders.
steps.routing_rationale: Tool execution and JSON generation requires sub-second TTFT latency (243 tok/s). Premium reasoning models waste margin on deterministic tool calls.

steps.name: Send Run Summary
steps.desc: Dispatches execution confirmation email to stakeholders.
steps.routing_rationale: Tool execution and JSON generation requires sub-second TTFT latency (243 tok/s). Premium reasoning models waste margin on deterministic tool calls.

workflow_lab_results_inbox.verdict: Keep as Workflow. Strict orchestration and deterministic cell-level writes require predictability, not agentic hallucination risks.

workflow_daily_dashboard.name: 2. Aviva Daily Summary Dashboard
workflow_daily_dashboard.description: Scans the entire tracker state, categorizes 5 specific testing buckets, compiles actionable insights, and renders an Outlook-safe HTML report.

steps.name: Fetch Tracker State
steps.desc: Ingests total 10k rows of current lab statuses.
steps.routing_rationale: Massive context extraction. ₹42/1M token rate preserves margin on heavy document reads. Asynchronous batching prevents 60 RPM limit crashes.

steps.name: 5x Categorization (Parallel)
steps.desc: Groups lots into Overdue, Failed, Awaiting Lab B, etc.
steps.routing_rationale: Default fast router for standard classification and routing.

steps.name: Compile Executive Insights
steps.desc: Agent reasons over trends to highlight vendor delays.
steps.routing_rationale: Financial/Compliance logic requires absolute SOTA accuracy (TAU Banking #1). Trading margin for precision is mandatory here to prevent regulatory liabilities.

steps.name: Render Outlook HTML
steps.desc: Generates strict inline-styled HTML. LLM output here breaks Outlook.
steps.routing_rationale: Tool execution and JSON generation requires sub-second TTFT latency (243 tok/s). Premium reasoning models waste margin on deterministic tool calls.

steps.name: Send Dashboard Email
steps.desc: Dispatches daily HTML report to leadership.
steps.routing_rationale: Tool execution and JSON generation requires sub-second TTFT latency (243 tok/s). Premium reasoning models waste margin on deterministic tool calls.

workflow_daily_dashboard.verdict: Hybrid. Categorization and HTML rendering remain deterministic workflows. Insight Generation requires deep context reasoning and is upgraded to an Agent.

workflow_repeat_lot_detection.name: 3. Aviva UC3: Repeat Lot Detection (Agentic)
workflow_repeat_lot_detection.description: Agent must maintain state spanning multiple runs. If a vendor lot was tested within 6 months, skip waivable tests. If it failed prior, mandate full retest.

steps.name: Ingest New Lot
steps.desc: Receives new lot parameters.
steps.routing_rationale: Massive context extraction. ₹42/1M token rate preserves margin on heavy document reads. Asynchronous batching prevents 60 RPM limit crashes.

steps.name: Historical Memory Search
steps.desc: Queries vector DB for prior instances of this vendor lot.
steps.routing_rationale: Multi-step agentic state tracking requires superior context retention (63% Agentic Task Score). Prevents infinite loop hallucinations during complex cross-run memory tasks.

steps.name: Temporal Math
steps.desc: Calculates if prior test was within 180-day waiver window.
steps.routing_rationale: Financial/Compliance logic requires absolute SOTA accuracy (TAU Banking #1). Trading margin for precision is mandatory here to prevent regulatory liabilities.

steps.name: Waiver Execution
steps.desc: Applies material category rules and waives/mandates tests.
steps.routing_rationale: Multi-step agentic state tracking requires superior context retention (63% Agentic Task Score). Prevents infinite loop hallucinations during complex cross-run memory tasks.

workflow_repeat_lot_detection.verdict: Agent Required. Workflows are point-in-time. This requires tracking historical 6-month state and complex temporal logic across isolated runs.

workflow_two_lab_confirmation.description: Lab A fails -> send to Lab B -> wait days/weeks -> if both fail, Hard Rejection. Blocks the lot dynamically across time.

steps.name: Cross-Email Match
steps.desc: Days later, agent matches new email to suspended lot.
steps.routing_rationale: Multi-step agentic state tracking requires superior context retention (63% Agentic Task Score). Prevents infinite loop hallucinations during complex cross-run memory tasks.

workflow_proactive_lab_comms.name: 5. Aviva UC5: Proactive Lab Comms (Agentic)
workflow_proactive_lab_comms.description: Calculates per-lot ETAs based on lab SLA (e.g., Brighton=5d). Schedules proactive follow-ups. Parses lab replies for revised ETAs.

steps.name: Dynamic SLA Math
steps.desc: Calculates exact ETA date based on lab-specific SLAs.
steps.routing_rationale: Financial/Compliance logic requires absolute SOTA accuracy (TAU Banking #1). Trading margin for precision is mandatory here to prevent regulatory liabilities.

steps.name: Schedule Cron
steps.desc: Sets a reminder 2 days prior to ETA.
steps.routing_rationale: Tool execution and JSON generation requires sub-second TTFT latency (243 tok/s). Premium reasoning models waste margin on deterministic tool calls.

steps.name: Consolidate Lots
steps.desc: Agent bundles multiple delayed lots for the same lab into one email.
steps.routing_rationale: Default fast router for standard classification and routing.

steps.name: Parse Reply & Update
steps.desc: Reads lab reply, extracts new dates, updates DB, or escalates.
